claim: CodeMirror tracks composing count, first composition change, ended time, pending key, and pending change separately.
Safari compositionend/keydown ordering is guarded by a short pending-key window.
Composition start/update/end maintain state, pending change, Android delayed flush, and cleanup when no DOM change arrives.
Safari dead-key compositionend can be synthesized after insertText when the browser misses it.
DOM composition changes are replayed to secondary cursors only when safe; conflicting same-node composition ranges are ignored.
DOM selection sync avoids unnecessary writes and has browser-specific uneditable-node guards.
Composition DOM preservation refuses multi-line or model/DOM text mismatch cases.
Composition overlap detection is an explicit helper for deciding whether DOM preservation remains valid.
Android-style newline after composition is covered.
Composition cancels on fully overlapping, partially overlapping, or inside changes, but survives changes elsewhere.
Rapid consecutive compositions and multi-cursor composition constraints are tested.
IME span merging and text-node extension are tested.
CodeMirror can hide native selection and draw its own selection, accepting a layout cost for code-editor affordances.
Slate v2 already covers formatted-node IME replacement, rapid composition, and cross-paragraph native/synthetic composition.
Slate v2 already covers async decoration refresh during active composition.
Slate v2 stress coverage includes synthetic IME selection repair, inline void boundary, and composition undo.
